en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued this morning
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning at 7am as heat-stress levels rose under the ongoing Very Hot Weather Warning, advising employers to arrange rest breaks for outdoor and…
body: The Labour Department issued the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning at 7am on Saturday, indicating that heat stress in some work environments is relatively high.

The warning is based on the Hong Kong Heat Index. Employers of outdoor workers or those in non-air-conditioned indoor settings should assess heat-stress risks and take practical measures, including rescheduling work, providing shade or ventilation, and arranging rest breaks according to the department’s guidelines.

Workers are advised to rest in cooler areas and drink water if they experience symptoms such as headache, dizziness, thirst or nausea, and to notify their supervisors. The Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force, with extremely hot conditions expected to continue.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告今早生效
zh.dek: 勞工處上午7時發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高；酷熱天氣警告同時生效，僱主應為戶外及無空調室內工作員工安排適當休息。
body: 勞工處今日上午7時發出黃色工作暑熱警告，顯示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。
警告以香港暑熱指數為依據。僱主應評估戶外或沒有空調室內工作環境的熱壓力風險，並在合理地切實可行情況下採取預防措施，包括重新編排工作時段、提供遮蔭或通風設備，以及按指引安排每小時適當休息時間。
僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴或噁心等熱疾病徵狀，應立即到陰涼處休息及飲水，並通知僱主或管方。酷熱天氣警告繼續生效，極端高溫天氣預計持續。
